notes: Regression probe for the wrap ghosts (engine/README.md#wrap-ghosts), added by the raster-engineer in M3 stage 3.5; the two profile locks are for the Technical Director to confirm. Five static layouts, 32 frames each, cycling (160 frames a cycle), all with sprites at Y 30-55 whose hardware sprites end the frame there. The top border is DMA-free once the ghosts are parked, so mux_irq_top is exact.
